Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: AliExpress's mystery box opening - on the game screen, tapping Open dims the page while the 3D treasure chest zooms center, shakes, pops its lid with a light burst, then a "Congrats!" modal reveals the gem reward (+80/+100) and the gem counter counts up.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Colorful blue game screen: "MYSTERY BOXES" header, progress bar with tier milestones, a 3D golden chest on a platform ringed by item cards, a pink "Open" button, and bottom nav. The reveal modal is dark with "Congrats!", a "You've got +80" gem line, reward item slots, and a "Claim now" gradient button.

## Motion spec
Pattern: 3D box-open ritual + reward modal + count-up, ~2.5s.
- Anticipation: tapping Open dims the background (black 60%, 250ms); the chest zooms to center (scale 1 -> 1.6, 400ms, ease-out) and shakes with building intensity (rotation -4deg -> 4deg, 3 rounds, tightening).
- Pop: the lid flips open with a spring (~280/16), golden light rays burst from inside (scale 0 -> 1.3 fade, 400ms), and a glow ring expands past the chest.
- Reveal: the "Congrats!" modal slides up and scales in (spring ~340/22, 350ms); the gem icon drops in with a bounce (spring ~300/15).
- Count-up: the header gem counter rolls to the new total (600ms, ease-out) after claim, with a sparkle on landing.

## Calibration
- The shake ramps - slow wobble to fast jitter over ~900ms, never constant.
- The chest stays 3D-lit throughout; the light burst comes from inside the box.

## Reduced motion
Chest cross-fades to open; modal and counter appear with 250ms fades.

## Don't miss
- The Claim button is a pink-to-purple gradient pill, matching the Open button.
- The reward amount varies (+80 vs +100) - the counter animates the actual delta.
